name: Fallen Sky Lake
summary: At Fallen Sky Lake, Shadethickets defend the shores and central isle between Silverwing Outpost and the Warsong Labor Camp.

sections.title: A Contested Sanctuary
sections.body:
South of Silverwing Outpost and west of the Warsong Labor Camp, Fallen Sky Lake draws you into contested waters. Hulking Shadethickets roam the shore and the small isle at its center, treating intruders as threats.

A powerful Shadethicket Oracle rules from the isle's heart. The Oracle hoards the fallen moonstones once gathered here and keeps the shadethickets bound to the lake, watchful for travelers.

faq.q: Where is Fallen Sky Lake located?
aliases: how to find fallen sky lake
faq.answer: Fallen Sky Lake lies in eastern Ashenvale, south of Silverwing Outpost, west of the Warsong Labor Camp, and northeast of Silverwing Grove.

faq.q: What creatures live around Fallen Sky Lake?
aliases: what is at fallen sky lake
faq.answer: Aggressive Shadethickets roam Fallen Sky Lake and its banks. A Shadethicket Oracle leads them from the central isle.

faq.q: Why is the Shadethicket Oracle important?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle leads the shadethickets at the lake and hoards the fallen moonstones night elves once gathered there. Anyone who needs a moonstone must slay the Oracle on the central isle.

angles.text: As a druid, you know night elves once gathered moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake. Shadethicket bog beasts now claim its waters, making this quiet forest corner dangerous.
As a night elf, you find Fallen Sky Lake just south of Silverwing Outpost, in your sacred ancestral forest. Wild beasts have grown erratic amid the Horde's gathering drums.
